craft_notes: Sthāyin: breath-order (in-first, out-at-end: no-gap: the ORDER is the goddess: the verse makes sequence sacred — refrains of grace). Sanskrit: pūrvo 'dhogo bhaved ādir antyogo bahir antataḥ...kramaḥ...sandhi...śaktimān → L4 keeps in-out line 1, gapless-order line 2. Rows: row 2 (order-without-gap→goddess shines). Close: shines (prakāśate — the shining-verb of blocks returns: GODDESS shines, not light-object: the shine transfers). Rejected: 'prāṇāyāma' label — killed: inhalation-exhalation kept plain; 'seam' — killed: gap kept (sandhi: the joining-point of breaths: nothing between, NOTHING kept).

lines: the one's order without gap — goddess of power shines.
l4.sanskrit_cite: nistaraṅgopadeśānāṃ śatam uktaṃ samāsataḥ | dvādaśābhyadhikaṃ devi yaj jñātvā jñānavij janaḥ
